configuration.instructions:
*** Operational Instructions ***
1. Alert when "ConsecutiveFailures" is above 2 in table sig_refresh_health.
2. Alert when "DurationVsBaselinePct" is above 200 in table sig_refresh_health.
3. For failures recommend: retry the refresh once; if "ConsecutiveFailures" is above 4, recommend disabling the refresh schedule and opening a ticket.
4. For slow refreshes recommend opening a ticket only.
*** Semantic Instructions ***
1. Each semantic model is identified by "SemanticModelId".
2. "LastErrorMessage" is the error of the latest failed refresh.
3. "BaselineDurationMin" is the median successful refresh duration over the last 14 days.

00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.description: Opens an ITSM ticket with the model, error and owner.
